name: ⚡BALTHAZAR
desc:
BALTHAZAR is an in-development melee & ranged fighting game. It's built around constant action and aggression, so playing safe won't get you far.
The game is in BETA state, bugs may occur, if you encounter any - please report them on our communication server.

💕Use code 50K_LIKES to get free rewards. Next code on 60K likes!
✨2X Event every Friday, Saturday and Sunday!
⚙️Type /cmds in chat to see available PS commands
🎮Tips:
- Damage might register with a slight delay due to opponent's ping compensation. This affects everyone equally, keeping things fair for all players;
- Rolling provides Invincibility Frames, allowing you to phase through attacks, protecting you from damage.

🏷️sword fighting, skill based, souls-like, dark fantasy, soulslike, FFA, PvP, battleground, souls like, arena, duels, medieval, parry, knight, free for all, deflect.
